Implementation Plan I've read the P4 spec, the P1–P3 code that's already on the branch, and the reuse candidates. Here is the plan. **Planning ref:** `orchestrator/project-8427` at `ff604222eeb11b9a0e12e9ef479d54144a30a814` (integration branch mismatch: false). Spec: `docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md`, sections "Phases & Merge Strategy" item 4 and "Implementation Steps › P4: Evidence packs". P1 (#8428), P2 and P3 are on this ref (`scripts/attempt_journal.py`, `scripts/acceptance_check.py`, repair-loop wiring). Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends scripts/gh_api_retry.py call(optional=True), attempt_journal._scrub and targeted_file_context.extract_paths_from_plan Scope-mode justification: P4 ships exactly what the spec assigns it. That is the new host-only `scripts/evidence_pack.py` (open PRs touching the same paths, per-path `git log` subjects, recent default-branch run results, at most 4 API calls, a byte cap, fail-open) and its wiring into clarify, plan and implement behind `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED` (default `false`) and `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_MAX_BYTES` (default `12000`). Nothing from P5–P11 is included. Under the Boil the Lake rule the plan takes the complete option in three cheap places, each well under 30 LOC with no new dependency or interface. First, the git history fetch is guarded so it can never make a full clone shallow. Second, the open-PR filter (same repo, trusted authors) is locked by a test. Third, clarify and plan get a free-text path scan, because the spec's `extract_paths_from_plan` only reads a `## Files likely to change` section. All three serve §6 correctness and safety. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/evidence_pack.py` (new) - `tests/test_evidence_pack.py` (new) - `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh` - `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` - `.github/workflows/plan.yml` - `.github/workflows/implement.yml` - `tests/test_workflow_untrusted_input_contract.py` - `agents.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md` (new) - `changelog.d/8427-p4-persist-evidence-pack.md` (new) ## Functions or modules to implement **1. `scripts/evidence_pack.py` (new; tabs, module docstring in the style of `acceptance_check.py`)** CLI: `build --repo R --out F [--default-branch B] [--repo-root D] [--paths-file F] [--text-file F] [--plan-file F] [--max-bytes N]` - The command always exits 0 once arguments parse. Usage errors exit 2, as in `acceptance_check.py`, but no caller passes bad arguments. `enabled()` - True only when `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED` is `true`; the default is `"false"` inside the helper (§8). - When off, `build` writes nothing, makes no calls and logs `PERSIST evidence_pack outcome=skipped calls=0 bytes=0 reason=switch_off`. `max_bytes(arg)` - Uses `--max-bytes`, else `PERSIST_EVIDENCE_PACK_MAX_BYTES`, else `12000`. - A non-integer gives 12000. The value is clamped to 1024..65536. `collect_paths(paths_file, text_file, plan_file, repo_root)`, at most 10 paths in order: 1. `--paths-file`: one path per line. 2. `--plan-file`: `targeted_file_context.extract_paths_from_plan` run on the text from the last `## Files likely to change` heading onward (the newest plan when re-planning). 3. `--text-file`: the same section extraction, then a free-text scan with `targeted_file_context.PATH_IN_BACKTICKS_RE` plus `normalize_path` / `is_probable_path`. Every candidate is checked: - after normalising, it is relative, contains no `..`, does not start with `-` or `.git/`, and has no NUL or control characters; - it exists under `repo_root` once resolved (no escape through a symlink); - free-text candidates must also be tracked (`git ls-files --

`, one batched call through the argv list). `_gh(args, idempotent=False)` - Copy the pattern of `attempt_journal._gh` (`gh_api_retry.call(args, optional=True)`, with the plain `gh api` fallback and `reason=gh_api_retry_unavailable` when the import fails). - Count every logical call. `open_prs(repo, paths)` - Call 1: `repos//pulls?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=50` (no `--paginate`). - Keep a PR only when `head.repo.full_name == repo` and the author is `user.login == "github-actions[bot]"` or `author_association` is one of OWNER, MEMBER, COLLABORATOR. This ports the jq filter in `activation_open_prs_json` (`scripts/activation_verify.sh:273-301`). - Calls 2–3: one aliased GraphQL query per 25 PRs, at most 2 queries: - shape: `query($owner:String!,$name:String!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$name){p:pullRequest(number:){files(first:100){nodes{path}}}}}`; - owner and name are passed as `-f` variables; `` is an int already checked by `isinstance`; - sent with `idempotent=True`. - Render `#N — ` for PRs with at least one overlap, at most 10 PRs, no bodies. - The GraphQL calls are skipped when no paths were found. `history(repo_root, default_branch, paths)`, no API calls: - `git fetch --no-tags --no-write-fetch-head ... origin +refs/heads/:refs/persist/history`, with `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0` and a 60 s timeout. - The fetch is guarded (decision D2): - `--depth=200` only when `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` prints `true`; - `--filter=blob:none` only when `git config extensions.partialclone` is `origin`; - otherwise a plain fetch. - Per path, at most 10 paths: `git log -n 8 --format=%h %as %s refs/persist/history -- ` as an argv list. Subjects are capped at 120 chars. - A fetch failure gives the line `history unavailable`. `branch_health(repo, default_branch)` - Call 4: `repos//actions/runs?branch=&status=completed&per_page=10`. - Render ` ` from the workflow `name` field, not `display_title`, which can carry PR titles. No logs. `resolve_default_branch(arg)` - Uses `--default-branch`, else `repository.default_branch` from `$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`. - The name must match `^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]{1,200}$` and contain no `..`, no leading `-` and no `.lock` suffix. Otherwise the history and health sections are skipped with `reason=default_branch_unknown`. `render(sections, max_bytes)` - `=== BEGIN UNTRUSTED EVIDENCE PACK (host-built; titles and subjects are third-party text) ===`, then sections `OPEN PULL REQUESTS TOUCHING THESE PATHS`, `RECENT HISTORY`, `DEFAULT BRANCH RUNS`, then `=== END UNTRUSTED EVIDENCE PACK ===`. - Each untrusted line goes through `attempt_journal._scrub`. That function already does the gate scripts' neutralise/scrub (`::`, `##[`, `
